maria_marketing: Quick dashboard flash 1: need final MQLs and influenced pipeline from last week's launch posts + webinar for Friday's KPI review. Can we lock numbers by 4pm PT?

olivia_analytics: On it. Current pull: MQLs total 328 (webinar 172, blog/launch posts 90, paid social 66). CTR avg for launch emails/posts 2.3%. Influenced pipeline preliminary $465k. Will validate after ingestion.

sam_growth: Any routing backlogs? Saw a small bump in TTL on leads yesterday.

rita_ops: Ingestion laged between 10:40-12:05 PT due to SFDC API rate limits (~22% of records delayed). Eng-sre applied a throttling backoff. Hotfix tracked in #eng-sre-4291.

lee_sales: FYI a few MQLs routed late showed up in AE queues this morning, caused slight follow-up delay. We should include routing SLA notes in the slide.

jon_product: Messaging A/B: short CTA (variant B) pushed more traffic to the webinar landing but didn't improve MQL conversion. Will add funnel screenshot.

maria_marketing: Adding ask: include a sensitivity slide showing how attribution window affects webinar credit (7d vs 28d). Olivia can you run?

olivia_analytics: Yep. Quick calc: moving to 28d ups webinar-attributed pipeline by ~52% and increases registrant counts by ~40 for the March cohort. I'll attach a small table and the SQL I used.


```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', registered_at) as cohort,
       source,
       count(*) as regs
FROM leads
WHERE registered_at >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1 desc;
```

maria_marketing: Perfect. Sam, you and I will synthesize narrative (top 3 wins, top 3 risks). Lee, can you add a quick seller note about follow-up timing impact?

sam_growth: Yep. I'll own the metrics slide + sensitivity table. Olivia will produce visuals. Maria narrative.

rita_ops: Post-deploy check: ingestion reconciled at 12:40 PT. I validated counts vs event logs; mismatch <1.2%.

lee_sales: Thanks Rita. I'll note seller impact: ~6% of handoffs were >24h delayed. Want that in the risk slide.

olivia_analytics: Uploading slides to drive now: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch_q2_flash (will add appendix with raw cohort CSV).

maria_marketing: Final ask: one-line takeaway for exec slide. Draft: "Webinar drove the majority of pipeline lift; attribution window materially changes crediting9; routing delays introduced minor GTM friction." Thoughts?

jon_product: Clean and accurate. Maybe shorten: "Webinar = main lift; attribution window doubles visible credit; routing delays created minor follow-up friction."

maria_marketing: Using Jon's version. Thanks everyone, see you 9am PT Friday. :thumbsup:
